# Academy of Art University

> > Academy of Art University is a San Francisco-based art and design school offering undergraduate and graduate degrees across fashion, game development, UI/UX design, architecture, acting, and fine arts.

The university provides comprehensive creative programs including MFA and MA degrees with emphasis on portfolio development, industry competitions, and hands-on training. Programs feature STEM-designated options in UI/UX Design and showcase student work through digital portfolios and exhibitions.

## Key Topics

- Academy of Art University
- San Francisco
- School of Fashion
- School of Interaction & UI/UX Design
- School of Game Development
- Master of Arts (MA)
- Master of Fine Arts (MFA)

## Graduate Degree Programs

- [Fashion Design (MFA)](https://www.academyart.edu/academics/fashion/degrees/fashion-design-mfa): MFA in Fashion Design program with pattern-making and garment construction
- [Fashion Art Direction (MA)](https://www.academyart.edu/academics/fashion/degrees/fashion-art-direction-ma): MA in Fashion Art Direction covering styling and visual merchandising
- [Fine Art (MA)](https://www.academyart.edu/academics/fine-art/degrees/fine-art-ma): MA in Fine Art with focus on drawing, painting, and portfolio development
- [Get Info About Graduate Education](https://www.academyart.edu/academics/get-info-graduate): Graduate program information request form for MFA/MA degrees

## Schools and Departments
